cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cfx C CXX)
add_library(util STATIC util/util.c)
target_include_directories(util PUBLIC api util)
add_library(extra STATIC extra/extra.c)
add_library(core STATIC core/core.c core/registry.c)
target_include_directories(core PUBLIC core)
add_library(plugin STATIC plugin/plugin.c)
target_link_libraries(plugin PUBLIC core util)
add_executable(app app/main.c)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE core plugin util extra)
add_library(circle STATIC circle/circle.cpp)
target_include_directories(circle PUBLIC shapes circle)
add_library(viewer STATIC viewer/viewer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(viewer PRIVATE circle)
